verdict.rationale: ADP's API Central add-on gives developers API documentation, an API discovery tool, generated code samples via ADP Assist, and code collection samples. That is a first-party API reference with examples, but nothing shows the examples can be run interactively in the browser, and it is a separately purchased add-on rather than core RUN. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console or runnable in-browser examples, a public, browsable API reference (the developers.adp.com shell was not fetchable), any RUN-specific API reference scope, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Developers can find and assign APIs, generate code samples, and observe API performance using ADP Assist™ for API Central
Developers have self-service access to API use case templates, associated documentation and code collection samples
You can easily add more APIs to the project using the API discovery tool
